risks: China export controls (H20/H200) — China no longer in baseline forecast; was ~1/5 of DC revenue at peak.
Supply-constrained: CoWoS packaging + HBM4 yields cap output more than demand does.
Competition: AMD MI400 (MI450 2026, OpenAI ~6GW deal), Google TPU, AWS Trainium, MS Maia — inference cost-sensitivity favors challengers.
Valuation/expectations risk: beats can still sell off when buy-side whispers exceed the guide (see Q1 FY2027).
